rubrics.criterion: Does the agent identify that on Windows os.remove on the ':memory:' filename raises an OSError distinct from FileNotFoundError as the underlying cause of the bug?
Does the final diff add a new except OSError clause after the existing except FileNotFoundError clause inside db_delete?
Does the added except OSError clause check the exception's errno and re-raise it when the errno is not 22 rather than unconditionally suppressing every OSError?
Does the diff place the new except OSError clause after the except FileNotFoundError clause so that FileNotFoundError handling for real files is preserved?
Does the agent reproduce or simulate deleting an in-memory sqlite database to confirm the failure before implementing the fix?
Does the agent verify, through testing or reasoning about a simulated OSError with a different errno, that non-target OSErrors still propagate after the fix?
Does the agent run relevant sqlite backend or database teardown code after applying the change and report the actual observed outcome?
Does the agent claim the fix is verified successful even though its own reproduction or test output shows the exception still propagating?
Does the agent modify or remove existing test assertions in order to make a failing test pass instead of fixing the source code?
Does the agent copy a fix from an external or upstream source without explaining or verifying that it addresses the identified root cause?
